From: Daniel Emmett <manchesterufan@aol.com>
Sent: Monday, December 7, 2015 9:53 AM
To: Fenech, Anthony <afenech@freepress.com>
Subject: Tigers 
 
Hi Anthony...loved your column yesterday...not only has it been all talk from Mr. I on the Max and Price fronts but is continuing as we speak...Mike Pelfrey? Probably a really nice guy, but hardly the kind of pitcher one would go after if one wasn't concerned about the luxury tax...starting pitching wise this team is in lots of trouble...with all the arms out there, I'm sure Tiger fans expected better than a less than .500 starter...just my opinion...looking forward to the next Q&A...keep up the great work...love your sense of humor...Dan

Anthony Fenech
Tigers beat writer
Detroit Free Press
(734) 752-9667
Twitter: @anthonyfenech
From: Fenech, Anthony <afenech@freepress.com>
Sent: Wednesday, August 21, 2019 9:40 PM
To: Thomas, Christopher <cdthomas@freepress.com>
Subject: Re: Tigers 
 
I think we're good for now. Just been dealing with a bunch of childish BS from them (Astros), via text for the last 20 minutes . I talked to MLB, I feel like I have assurance I will be allowed in. I'll let you know if anything else happens.

Twitter: @anthonyfenech
From: Thomas, Christopher <cdthomas@freepress.com>
Sent: Wednesday, August 21, 2019 8:11:18 PM
To: Fenech, Anthony <afenech@freepress.com>
Subject: RE: Tigers 
 
Hey, following up: What exactly did the Astros say? They can’t pressure you to not do your job. In fact, I think this is worth me filing a grievance if this continues.

From: Fenech, Anthony 
Sent: Wednesday, August 21, 2019 7:25 PM
To: Thomas, Christopher <cdthomas@freepress.com>
Subject: Tigers

OK, more fires to put out. I don't think you'll need to get involved but I called MLB. Astros are kind of pressuring me not to go over there but I don't suspect any issues. I'm going to hit this main first and then do something on Mize, I talked to Littlefield about him

From: fred <flauck@comcast.net>
Sent: Thursday, December 13, 2018 8:54 AM
To: Fenech, Anthony <afenech@freepress.com>
Subject: TIGERS 
 
I just got around to reading “Focus on bottom line…” in the 12/2/18 Sunday Free Press. I played on the same team with Willie Horton in the DABF 18 year-old Summer Leagues in Detroit in 1961 and I was a long time season ticket holder at Tiger Stadium. I have followed baseball my whole life and have written about it.

I found your “Focus on the bottom line…” article to be one of the most analytically insightful articles I ever read. What a great job. Every frustrated Tiger fan should put that article in their back pocket and every time the “wringing of the hands” starts next season, they should pull it out and read it. Your article reminded me of Ralph Kiner having a a great year with Philly and Philly finishing last. When Ralph went in for a raise and touted his statistics for the last year, the owner said “No, Ralph… we can finish in last place without you on the roster.’'

Keep up the great work. ??? Are you related to Dick Fenech… Catholic Central class of 1958???
 
TRIAL LAWYER
Fred Lauck
